name: a2uicatalog-docs
description: A genuinely separate MCP server from a2uicatalog (https://a2uicatalog.ai/mcp): this one answers questions FROM this product's own documentation (auth, versioning, pricing, API surface, runbook catalog) rather than taking product actions. search_docs(query) returns ranked, real (never fabricated) sections with the source URL.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search this product's documentation (auth, versioning, pricing, API surface, runbook catalog) for a plain-English query. Returns ranked sections with a snippet and the real source URL — never fabricated content.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: List indexed documentation sections (title, section, url) without a search query, for browsing the full indexed set.
